feeds.title: Multisport Research Blog
feeds.description: Multisport Research Blog gives news & industry findings on endurance sports market trends. MultiSport Research was founded in 2010 with a single mission: to be the most successful, creative, and ground-breaking consulting agency for the international endurance sports industry.

feeds.title: Multisport Nutrition Blog
feeds.description: Practical and realistic nutrition and food tips for athletes and active people. Recipes, tips, and food hacks. Info on Triathlon nutrition, female athlete nutrition, ironman recipes, triathlon recipes, marathon swim nutrition, and more. Christie Robson found Multisport Nutrition to support ultra-endurance athletes and people who swim, bike, and run at all levels and ages.

feeds.title: Sculpting You Strong Blog
feeds.description: Sculpting You Strong has Blog articles on Triathlons, Running, Cycling, Swimming, or even fitness, and nutrition. I am Tushar Bhangale, founder & coach at SculptingYouStrong MultiSport. I help people to improve performance by training for running and triathlons!

feeds.title: MultiSport Canada
feeds.description: In The MultiSport Canada Triathlon Series news presented by Martins Family Fruit Farm you can find Wasaga beach eave start time info, Toronto Island wave start time info, Barrie Post race report, and much more! Multisport Canada is Canada's largest independent triathlon series & premier event management company.

feeds.title: Better Triathlete
feeds.description: Better Triathlete is an online triathlon training and multisport coaching community dedicated to helping athletes and coaches excel in the world of endurance. Our triathlon blog focuses on training, coaching, bikes, and gear. We help triathletes and coaches grow in the world of multisport.

feeds.title: Coach Patti Blog
feeds.description: Latest trends in fitness, health, and wellness. Tips relative to running and triathlon. Look for recipes, product reviews, and healthy living advice. Coach Patti is an Accredited Personal Trainer, Health Coach, and Clinical Exercise Specialist with the American Council of Exercise & USAT Certified Triathlon Coach.

feeds.title: Kairos Multisport Blog
feeds.description: Kairos represents you having your Kairos moment, your time to take action. There may never be a perfect time to start, but the opportune time is right now. Kairos Multisportall is about swimming, biking, and running. The musings of a GB Age Group Triathlete and sometimes a bit about life outside of training and racing.

feeds.title: RedAlert PT Multisport Blog
feeds.description: The RedAlert PT Blog site is where you can keep up to date with what has been happening with the RedAlert PT team and clients. RedAlert PT Multisport provides multisports coaching, strength and conditioning, and sports massage in St. Albans, UK. Also, supplying coaching programs Worldwide.

feeds.title: ATC Multisport Blog
feeds.description: ATC Multisport is the largest and most well-established triathlon and multisport club in South Africa. We seek to drive growth by promoting various formats of multisport, as well as the individual disciplines of cycling, swimming and running. Our aim is to attract athletes across a range of abilities, from complete beginners to elite athletes.

feeds.title: Catalyst Multisport Blog
feeds.description: Catalyst Multisport evolved from a desire to teach, train and educate those individuals who want to take responsibility for their own health and well-being and to see what they are truly capable of achieving. Our blog gives you health tips, nutrition, and sporty stories!

feeds.title: Wolfpack Blog
feeds.description: Wolfpack Multisport Coaching is a space for e-Learning, this space is to learn more about the world of triathlon from our perspective! Coach Anthony and Coach Maria will give you information on the latest technology or tips, tricks, and habit changes that can help you excel in the sport!

feeds.title: Multisport Philippines
feeds.description: Get all the latest news about your favorite sports and different sports personalities! Multisport Philippines' mission is to engage the active lifestyle community through inspiring stories, outdoor pursuits, fitness trends, and new adventures. We aim to bring national and international stories to a discerning audience.
